newsitem.title: USA: Coastal boosts 1996 gas output in Texas.
newsitem.headline: Coastal boosts 1996 gas output in Texas.

text.p: Coastal Corp said Wednesday its gas production rose to 180 million cubic feet per day from 20 million in 1996 after its exploration and production subsidiaries drilled extention wells in a country in Texas.
The company said its condensate output at the Jeffress area of Hildalgo County, Texas rose to 2,100 barrels a day from 480 barrels.
It also said it had successfully completed the drilling of a total of 14 wells in the area's Vicksburg formation in 1996 with plans to do developmental drilling in 1997.
Coastal is an energy holding company.
